# perfect-freehand 1.2.3

Source: https://github.com/steveruizok/perfect-freehand
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/perfect-freehand/-/perfect-freehand-1.2.3.tgz
License: MIT; see `LICENSE`.

`index.js` wraps the official `dist/cjs/index.js` build in an IIFE exposing
`window.PerfectFreehand`. The library source is otherwise unchanged. No build
step, network request, CDN or additional runtime dependency is required.
